description: Cross-language contract for the typed quarantine verdict (ADR-0086, ADR-0113): why the upload screen held a file back, as the ingest job stores it on FileProgress.quarantine and FileInfo.quarantine, and as the BFF stores it in documents.quarantine. Python: aiq_agent.knowledge.schema.QuarantineVerdict, built by ScreeningVerdict.to_model in sources/knowledge_layer/src/llamaindex/screening.py (tests/knowledge_layer_tests/test_quarantine_verdict_contract.py). TypeScript: verdictSchema in frontends/ui/src/lib/upload-screening/quarantine.ts (quarantine-verdict-contract.spec.ts). For each case Python asserts that `verdict` round-trips through the model unchanged (one serialised shape: term and sample only when set, pages_truncated and after_transcription only when true, omitted only when not zero, checked always) and, where `screen` is given, that screening its pages with its rules produces exactly `verdict`; the legacy `quarantined:` error_message is the same JSON behind the prefix. TypeScript asserts that verdictSchema reads `verdict` as `reads_as` (the verdict itself when absent; a kind it does not know becomes `other`), from the typed field and from the legacy string alike. `screen.pages` lists page ranges, `from`..`to` inclusive, each holding `text`; a `from` of null is a page without a numeric label. There is ONE copy: the spec reads this file from disk at run time.
